title: NUCLEAR REACTOR LABORATORY
description: Focuses on experimental investigation of the principles of nuclear reactor operation. Uses OSU TRIGA Reactor and other laboratory facilities. Covers preparation and presentation of laboratory reports.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: NSE 451*.
* May be taken concurrently.
A minimum grade of C is required in NSE 451.
meeting_html: T 2pm-3:50pm in RC 104D - Radiation Center 104D (9/23 to 12/4)
